title: Working with Mary Martin and Helen Morgan
summary: He recalls Mary Martin's Broadway shows and nightclub work with Helen Morgan.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: And then later on, Lee, didn't you work with Mary Martin, Ginger Rogers and Helen Morgan?

Yes, Mary Martin played in the Broadway show, Louisiana Hayride and also Hollywood Follies. And these other people, I worked with Helen Morgan, too, several times in nightclubs and also taught a girl who went with her show as a course girl.
